name: Bento
about: The Unmissed Bento language (bright tiles, soft layered shadows, a camera gliding across a grid) in the client's colours: opens on the title tile, pulls back to the whole grid, glides to the real photo, the fact tile (a measured figure when the brief names one), a Book online tile, then the tiles collapse into the mark on the end card. Each close-up's zoom keeps that tile's words inside the R-2-08 safe box.
